section_summary.extract_value: This section details the measures used in the study. Creative achievement was assessed using a Swedish-adapted CAQ, covering 7 domains (visual arts, dance, music, theater, writing, invention, and science), with an additional scoring method focusing on maximum achievement (MAX_ART, MAX_SCI) also explored. Personality was measured with the Big Five Inventory (BFI), and psychometric intelligence with the Wiener Matrizen Test (WMT).
